headline: Daily Bible
Widget.
frames.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
frames.mission: Recognize a daily Bible widget immediately, using the liked r3 composition plus a Bible book.
frames.scenario: I reach for my phone during a busy morning. Scripture is already on the Lock Screen, before I open another app.
frames.proof: Existing Lock Screen widget; enlarged verse composition; Bible prop is a source cue, not an app theme.

headline: Bible comfort
for hard days.
frames.verse: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
frames.mission: Show a familiar worry and a relevant Bible passage as the concrete result.
frames.scenario: I am worried about tomorrow. I write it in my own words, then read a Bible passage about anxiety.
frames.proof: MainView heartSection supports own-word input and Find verses. The example BSB verse exists in the anxious content. Editorial example, not a verified exact search ranking.

headline: Too tired to read?
Listen & pray.
frames.subtitle: Hear a Bible verse & prayer.
frames.label: A QUIET MOMENT BEFORE BED
frames.verse: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
frames.mission: Make audio immediately recognizable, connected to an evening Bible habit.
frames.scenario: At bedtime I want Scripture but am tired of reading. I open Tonight and play the verse and prayer.
frames.proof: TonightContent → ListenButton → AudioService; PSA.3.5 has a bundled BSB recording. Enlarged play control; no invented waveform or duration.
